executive_summary: Independent six-check review of the 20 Nov 2026 09:20 ET freeze (candidate 94f79ebc…): the bytes hash to candidate.sha256 and are byte-identical to data/current.json, structural-flags.json is [], and publish.py --check reports a valid structure with no flags. Official policy reproduces on the primaries: the Fed held 3-3/4 to 4 percent on 28 Oct by 10-2 with Cook and Hammack preferring +1/4, 'inflation remains elevated', 'expanding at a strong pace' (federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261028a.htm); the BoC raised 25bp to 2.50% with Bank Rate 2.75% and deposit 2.45%, CPI 'about 3½% by the end of the year' and 3% average in 2027 (bankofcanada.ca/2026/10/fad-press-release-2026-10-28/); next meetings are 9 Dec for both (BoC 09:45 ET, FOMC second day 14:00 ET, the 2026 calendar reads December 8-9). Pricing is level and reproducible: the Kalshi December ladders re-derive from the printed midpoints (Fed 0.035/0.915/0.055/0.005/0.005, raw 1.015 -> 93.5/5.5/1.0; BoC 0.010/0.580/0.430/0.005/0.005, raw 1.030 -> 57.3/41.7/1.0) and Polymarket is 1.15pp away on the Fed hike bucket and 1.8pp on the BoC. Drivers: all fifteen Fed and six BoC entries trace to the claimed institutions (Fed statement, minutes, Waller/Jefferson/Bowman/Barr/Warsh/Hammack, Census MARTS, BEA PIO, StatCan GDP/LFS/CPI/retail, BoC press release and opening statement); the reaction numbers reproduce to the contract on the venue candles (68,547; 28,077; 748,703; 345,470; 19,331/3,721; 19,102/24,039; 323; 106,046), every weight_breakdown sums to its weight, mean |weight| is 2.33 Fed / 2.17 BoC, and the decay arithmetic gives 21.25 / -2.5. BLS returns 403 to this host, so payrolls 165k / unemployment 4.1% / participation 61.9% / AHE +0.4% and +3.1% / core CPI +0.3% were re-derived from FRED (PAYEMS, UNRATE, CIVPART, CES0500000003, CPILFESL) rather than taken on trust; the October control-group 0.6% and the September 0.5%-from-0.1% revision are corroborated outside the MARTS PDF. All three majors from the 18 Nov REVISE are closed against the new bytes and the venue: both 9 Dec calendar forecast strings now match the pricing cards (Hike 93.5 / Hold 5.5 / cut 1.0 and Hike 57.3 / Hold 41.7 / cut 1.0, both stamped 20 Nov 09:06), and the notes now put the BoC 17 Nov close at 0.44/0.46 (the 23:00 ET candle) with 0.41/0.43 correctly identified as that day's 13:00 candle, which the candlesticks confirm. Freshness passes at 26 minutes. Four minors go to the next cycle, all post-snapshot or presentational: BlueGamma's BoC page now prints 55/45 (was 58/42, +14bp unchanged), its Fed page now prints +25bp (was +26bp, 100% unchanged), Polymarket's Fed hike bucket has ticked 95.0 -> 96.15, and the notes' parenthetical that the Gravelle speech page serves 'the media advisory only' is wrong - the remarks are published in full, though they carry no December policy signal and the unattributed-repricing conclusion stands. No critical or major finding; the snapshot is fit to publish.

findings.issue: BlueGamma's CORRA OIS page is quoted at 58% hike / 42% hold, and the notes' 'three venues inside 1.7pp today' rests on that reading (Kalshi 57.3 / Polymarket 59 / BlueGamma 58). Re-read at 09:36 ET the page prints 55% hike / 45% hold / 0% cut with the same +14bp and the same date-only stamps, so the three-way spread is 4.2pp rather than 1.7pp. The page carries no clock time ('As of 20 Nov 2026', 'Last update: 19 Nov 2026'), so this cannot be time-aligned: it is post-snapshot repricing, not an operator misread, and 4.2pp is still inside the 5pp tolerance.

The page now prints +25bp with the same 100% / 0% / 0% and the same date-only stamps, so the basis gap is 0.8bp and the 'more than the 25bp step' explanation no longer describes the page. Nothing in the ledger moves: the hike bucket is 100% either way.

findings.issue: The notes place 'Gravelle's Edmonton speech' inside the 14:00-16:00 ET window on 18 November and add 'the Bank's speech page still serves the media advisory only, with the text unpublished'. That parenthetical is false: the speech page carries the full remarks (Toni Gravelle, Edmonton Chamber of Commerce, 18 November 2026, 'Setting the scenario: Monetary policy communications in uncertain times'), and no time is printed on it while the text opens 'Good morning', so its position inside the 14:00-16:00 window is unsupported. The conclusion the sentence supports still holds - the remarks are about communications strategy and carry no December policy signal, so the 9.0pp BoC step remains an unattributed repricing with no scored driver.
